case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.
